{{Quote|I am Kiki of the Dorente sept, advisor to the Neetha den mother.|Kiki Dorente, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtK" />}}
'''Kiki Dorente''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|It appears the smugglers have some of the den's people, and are using them to coerce the rest of the den into mining for them. I need you to talk to Kiki Dorente and see if you can help her with the den's problems.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Travel to Talus|Talus}}</ref>}}
Kiki Dorente was a Selonian [[sept]] who belonged to the [[Neetha Den]], a Selonian [[Den (Selonian)|den]] that inhabited a [[Neetha Den's cave|cave]] near Nashal, on the planet Talus. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she served as the advisor to the [[Kiisa Kimotte|Neetha den mother]].<ref name="SWG:TtK" />

[[File:FindingaWeakness-CotF.png|thumb|left|200px|Dorente hired a spacer to reconnoiter the Smuggler Base]]
After the Battle of Yavin, several Selonians of the den were captured by the [[Talusian Smugglers]] and kept as hostages in order to exploit the rest of the den.<ref name="SWG:TtT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] was aware of the situation but was unable to intervene in Selonian matters. [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] thus recruited an independent spacer to help the Selonians without involving the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:TtT" /> The spacer met Kiki Dorente in her cave, and the Selonian accepted the assistance.<ref name="SWG:TtK" /> She first tasked the spacer with reconnoitering the [[Smuggler Base]] where her denmates were supposedly held. After the spacer returned to the Selonian cave with the information requested, Kiki and other Selonian mates developed a strategy against the smuggler.<ref name="SWG:FaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Finding a Weakness" on Talus</ref> [[Tika Sileste]] requested the spacer eliminate the smuggler guards and destroy the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the base.<ref name="SWG:EaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Exploiting a Weakness" on Talus</ref> [[Ravi Thienta]] asked the spacer to recover stolen Selonian's supplies and destroy the smugglers' weapons cache.<ref name="SWG:UYT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Under Your Thumb" on Talus</ref> [[Lika Fimente]] tasked the spacer with finding the captive Selonians in the base.<ref name="SWG:GtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Gather the Missing" on Talus</ref> Furthermore, Kiki Dorente sent the spacer back to the smuggler base in order to gather information about the destination of the cargo shuttles leaving the base.<ref name="SWG:FaW" /> Although the spacer achieved most of the objectives, the assault was only a partial success. The spacer defeated most of the smugglers, including their leader,<ref name="SWG:EaW" /> and crippled their ability to exploit the Selonians.<ref name="SWG:UYT" /> However, the spacer discovered that the captive Selonians had already been shipped to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="SWG:GtM" /> As the situation with the smugglers was concluding, Kiki eventually introduced the spacer to the den mother, who thanked the spacer for the great assistance.<ref name="SWG:AtDM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Address the Den Mother|Talus}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KikiDorente.jpg|150px|thumb|Randomly generated depiction of Kiki Dorente]]
[[File:TemplateSelonianScout.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Kiki Dorente]]
Kiki Dorente appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kiki Dorente was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
